name: notebook-layout
description: Design your application to look like a notebook.

scripts.build:tokens: npm run build:coreui && sass --no-source-map --load-path=styles/ds styles/ds/tokens.scss /dev/null && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed --load-path=styles/ds styles/ds/ds.scss styles/ds/dist/ds.css && node scripts/ds/check-collisions.mjs styles/ds/dist/ds.css && node scripts/ds/check-dangling-refs.mjs styles/ds/dist/ds.css && node scripts/ds/check-state-families.mjs styles/ds/dist/ds.css && node scripts/ds/check-fallback-values.mjs styles/ds/dist/ds.css && node scripts/ds/check-layer3-bypass.mjs styles/ds/src/adapters && node scripts/ds/check-token-grammar.mjs styles/ds/src/_component.scss && node scripts/ds/check-custom-prop-interpolation.mjs components styles && node scripts/ds/check-theme-proof.mjs components styles ../www/src && node scripts/ds/check-dumb-components.mjs components styles/components --allow=0
scripts.lint:layers: npx stylelint "components/**/*.scss" "styles/**/*.scss" --config stylelint.config.cjs && node scripts/ds/check-orphan-reads.mjs components styles ../www/src
